summary.text: David Linsky is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives who has represented the 5th Middlesex District since 1999 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Linsky's Ballotpedia profile lists a bachelor's degree from Colby College and a law degree from Boston College Law School in 1982.

Linsky's professional experience includes working as an attorney in private practice, as an assistant district attorney of Middlesex County, and at the firm Witner, Karp, Warner & Thvotte and as an attorney for Campbell and Associates.
Linsky took office in 1999 and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

For the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the Public Safety and Homeland Security, Tourism, Arts and Cultural Development, and Transportation joint committees, and served as vice chair of the Revenue Joint Committee.
